description:
"You can't run away anymore. 'Cause I'm going to devour you whole right here." 

Soojung slept with a man she met at a bar that seemed like the devil had possessed him. A few months later, Soojung is hired at the Hansung Group's secretarial office, and against the odds, that same man happens to be her boss, Director Kang Inha. Upon their meeting, he shows no recollection of ever knowing Soojung. She tries to block out the memories from that steamy night, but her heart can't help but tremble at the mere thought of it. 

"This might sound crazy, but... Have we met here before?" 

I'm trying to forget about you, but why is it you are making me such a mess right now?
